## PR Type
What kind of changes does your Pull Request introduce?
- [ ] Bugfix
- [ ] Feature (Enhancement)
- [ ] Documentation / Policy Update
- [ ] Configuration / Setup

## Description
Please describe the motivation for the change and what architectural layers (UI, AI-routing, Database schema, Guardrails) were impacted.

## Related Issues
Closes #[issue number or link]

## Checklist Before Requesting Review
- [ ] My code strictly adheres to the standard styling rules using **Tailwind CSS**.
- [ ] I have compiled the client successfully (`npm run build`) and no ESLint warnings were raised.
- [ ] All high-risk mutations have been sandboxed and validated locally against sample SQLite instances.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation if relevant (e.g. `FEATURES.md`, `INSTALLATION.md`).
- [ ] No personal credentials, GitHub tokens, or private workspace paths are left in the diff.
